💡 The novelty lies in pairing a strong cosolvent (DMSO) with a weak one (DMC) to spatially decouple solvation-shell stabilization from outer-shell buffering, yielding nonlinear kinetic optimization absent in single-cosolvent systems. Significance: ~40% lower charge-transfer barrier, regulated SEI, and preserved thermodynamic stability, establishing strong–weak cosolvent synergy as a design principle for practical aqueous Zn batteries.

💡 The novelty lies in a deep eutectic electrolyte using succinonitrile and dimethyl sulfone with competitive coordination, shifting Li+ solvation from aggregates to balanced AGG/CIP distribution. Advanced Materials | ⭐ Review
💡 This review uniquely deconstructs LRMO rate limits across three levels—charge transport, anionic redox kinetics, and degradation cascades—revealing that the rate-determining step shifts from electron transfer to ion diffusion, governed by j0 and jd. It highlights the overlooked charging bottleneck from asymmetric anionic redox and critiques cross-study C-rate comparability, providing a theoretical foundation for rational high-rate cathode design.

item.description:

item.title: Electronic Modulation via Dual‐Phase Coupling of CoNi Alloy and NiCo 2 S 4 on N, S‐Co‐Doped Porous Carbon Spheres for High‐Performance Rechargeable Zn‐Air Batteries
item.description:
ساخت هتروساختار دوفازی CoNi/NiCo2S4 روی کربن متخلخل دوپ‌شده با N و S، با تنظیم الکترونی، کاتالیزور دوفункسیونی اکسیژن برای باتری Zn-air با ولتاژ مدار باز 1.44 V و ظرفیت بالا ارائه می‌دهد.
Small | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in controlled partial sulfidation creating a CoNi alloy/NiCo₂S₄ dual-phase heterostructure on N,S-codoped porous carbon, preserving alloy conductivity while adding sulfide active sites. This interfacial electronic modulation optimizes oxygen-intermediate adsorption, enabling superior bifunctional ORR/OER activity and durable flexible Zn-air batteries (1.44 V, 656.77 mAh g⁻¹, >100 h), establishing partial sulfidation as a general design strategy.
🏷 Zn-air battery · bifunctional oxygen electrocatalyst · CoNi alloy · NiCo2S4 heterostructure · DFT

item.title: Cation‐Anion Co‐Adsorption With Facet‐Preferential Tendency for Stable Wide‐Temperature Zinc‐Ion Batteries
item.description:

Small | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in a trace NH4I dual-ion additive enabling facet-preferential co-adsorption: I− guides uniform Zn deposition, while NH4+ shields tips and captures polyiodides, suppressing shuttling and side reactions. This low-polarization interphase delivers record stability—90.05% retention over 70,000 cycles at −30°C and 85.53% over 900 cycles in Zn/I2 pouch cells—breaking the low-temperature bottleneck for practical aqueous batteries.
🏷 zinc-ion battery · NH4I additive · facet-preferential adsorption · low temperature · polyiodide shuttle
